calculation.expression: -rolling_sum_5(asset_return - equal_weight_universe_return) / rolling_std_20(asset_return), lagged one day, activated for three days after breadth<50% and VIX above lagged 252-day 60th percentile
calculation.description: Volatility-scaled reversal of five-day cross-asset residual shocks. The signal is active during a persistent three-day window following broad weakness and elevated VIX, using only lagged information.

validation.regime_notes: No valid observations before 2026 due to VIX warm-up; 2026-2029 IC/ICIR 0.030333/0.110090; 2030-2032 0.023243/0.076910; recent 120 dates 0.019858/0.073017. Overall admission passes the benchmark gates, but recent stability is weaker and should be monitored.
